content.rendered:
The Heavy Duty Drying Towel gives you maximum absorbency with its 1200GSM dual layer construction. It pulls water from the surface quickly while staying soft and controlled.

The thick fibres create a premium, cushioned feel on paint, reducing contact pressure while leaving a clean, dry finish. It excels on larger vehicles and curved panels.

Perfect for those who want serious drying power without sacrificing safety.

WHY IT STANDS OUT:

  • Dual layer 1200GSM thickness
  • Extreme water absorption
  • Soft and paint safe
  • Premium heavy feel
  • Ideal for larger vehicles
